titulo: GTA 6 Is Like The Olympics – “A Rare Cultural Moment” With Massive Ripple Effects
texto: After years of development, multiple delays, and what can only be assumed to be one of the biggest production budgets ever, Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on November 19. The game is poised to "blot out the sun," some experts believe, and its release looms so large that other gaming companies are shifting dates for their own games to stay out of the blast radius.  Francis Lawrence, the director of the new Hunger Games movie Sunrise on the Reaping, which comes out a day after GTA 6, has said he hopes people can find the time to play the game and watch his movie . titulo: “Physical” GTA 6 Copies Might Be Vulnerable To A Very Stupid But Serious Trick
texto: Grand Theft Auto 6 ditched traditional discs for its "physical" launch, with Rockstar's game being sold as a digital code-in-box at retailers beginning this week. However, it appears a packaging choice may have accidentally left the game vulnerable to thieves--assuming they have a flashlight. As shared on the forum ResetEra , users who received a physical version of Grand Theft Auto 6, at least in PEGI regions, report that the game's download code is printed directly on the inside of the cover rather than on a card or separate insert. When a flashlight is focused on the cover from the outside of the closed game case, the download code is visible in reverse. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F7LIovDySBg&t=33s In other words, there's a serious risk people could go into a store, do this trick, redeem the code, and leave the poor soul who actually buys the game off the shelf without GTA 6.

titulo: GTA 6 Owner Take-Two Is Not Interested In Selling Itself After EA Goes Private For $55 Billion
texto: Recently, the gaming giant Electronic Arts was taken private in a $55 billion sale to an investor consortium led by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund. Could GTA 6 owner Take-Two be the next big company that gets acquired? Don't bet on it, CEO Strauss Zelnick says. Speaking to David Rubenstein , Zelnick said Take-Two's business results have proven that it "can do very well as an independent company." He said Take-Two's business is already "at scale" and healthy enough financially with a "terrific balance sheet," as he put it. "We are not in a place where we need to be part of a bigger organization to be competitive. And in the entertainment business, scale matters," he said. Zelnick said companies that do less than a billion in annual revenue might have issues with developing, marketing, and distributing games at scale.
